verdict.rationale: Checkout.com documents an official, hosted MCP Server with separate sandbox and production endpoints and OAuth sign-in through a Dashboard account. It gives a concrete Claude Code setup command and lists tools for searching docs, guided onboarding, and payment operations such as refunds, voids and payment links. missing for 10: the server is still labelled Beta, there is no independent or hands-on confirmation that the connection works, and setup is documented only for Claude Code rather than a range of agent clients.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: The Checkout.com Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server enables you to search through our knowledge base and manage payment operations directly from your AI-assisted integrated development environment (IDE).
Manage payment operations. Query payment statuses, issue refunds, void payments, and create and manage payment links
